message.content:
Based on the information provided in the messages, Li Hua did not explicitly mention preparing all the food before Wolfgang Schulz wished him a happy Lunar New Year. In the conversation regarding the Lunar New Year celebrations, Li Hua invited Wolfgang Schulz to join her at her place on January 18th, stating that "It'll be great to catch up and enjoy some good food together!" (Source: 3). However, Wolfgang Schulz replied by expressing his eagerness to celebrate with Li Hua and to enjoy some awesome food, suggesting that the food preparations were still ongoing. 

In the subsequent message, Wolfgang Schulz mentions that he has been off to Hong Kong for a couple of days, and Li Hua asks him if he has looked for any special snacks or a local souvenir. This indicates that Wolfgang Schulz was not yet back home to prepare any food for the celebration. Therefore, Wolfgang Schulz did not send a message wishing Li Hua a happy Lunar New Year after Li Hua had already prepared all the food, but rather before Wolfgang Schulz returned from his trip to Hong Kong.
